posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Got it on my third try.  Unity was MVP (not to be confused with an MDP) with two Platform bots, Mr. Chomps, Champion bot, Stealth bot, and Swift bot for oodles of damage, even with DR.  AZ  knocked out two Living Forcefields with a Fueled Freeze and got in some good damage with a well set-up Hoarfire + Coolant Blast combo, while Bunker held down the fort with two Adhesive-foam Grenades (and got in some regular grenades as well).

 

Had Blade half dead on his second side when Scum and Villany pulled out a Hasten Doom and a Slash and Burn.  Stealth bot managed to preserve my entire army from the Doom at the cost of her life, but the Slash and Burn took out a Platform Bot.  Volitile Parts hurt the Baron for that offense, as did AZ when it turned out that he was the highest HP hero when Blade came burning.  This put Blade at 6 hp, when on his turn he played... Devious Distruption.  But his deviousness was not enough to save him from my army of exploding robots.

 

After a challenge like that, let's take a break and shoot fish in a barrel.

 

Visionary, Legacy, Ra, Fanatic, and Absolute Zero to squish Grand Warlord Voss in Insula Primalis.  Bonus points if you drop him from over 50 hp in one strike.

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked:
Forgot to take a screen shot.

Managed to kill Spite without him flipping. Got really lucky. Tachyon managed to pull off two hypersonic assaults which kept him from healing. He got out his do damage whenever heroes use a power card, but this ended up helping out Tachyon a lot. I got lucky and managed to dry all three of my light speed barrages. On the last turn, Spite had all his drugs, but with HUD goggle and Pushing the Limits in play, Tachyon played all three lightspeed barrages for 19 damage each, the first one was 18 because of Spite's damage reduction, and brought him down to -7 HP. Basically Tachyon wailed on Spite while Unity and Fixer kind of helped.

New game: Tempest, Bunker, and AZ versus Voss in Atlantis. I tried this game once, and just couldn't do it. I'm sure it's winnable, a little difficult if Bunker doesn't start off with Flak Cannon or Grenade Launcher. Good luck, have fun.

That wasn't so hard in the end. Visionary took herself out early on with a Brain Burn (followed up by Haka going on a Rampage). Legacy never drew a single damage card, but got out his Legacy Ring-Next Evolution-Next Evolution combo, which naturally made it easy. I let an Oxygen Leak take out the Chairman at the end. EDIT: Oops, I keep forgetting The Chairman is immune to Environment damage. So Haka could have easily taken him out with a Haka of Battle.

I kept with the order you listed, which was a mistake, as Legacy was never able to take out any of the many Informants that showed up.
